text:
maria-partners: Quick question — when we ingest partner SKU bundles into the marketplace cost model, how should we align availability windows with billing boundaries? e.g., partner maintenance windows, reserved commit start/end, and spot eviction windows.
chris-vendor: prefer UTC for start/end to avoid timezone edge cases. maintenance windows are usually 02:00-04:00 UTC for most SKUs. reserved commits we sell align to partner invoice cycles though (monthly). :+1:
sam-finance: important: billing proration rules matter. If commit starts mid-billing-cycle we need clear rule (prorate by day vs hour). which do partners expect?
chris-vendor: we can support hour-level proration but invoice systems expect day-level by default. we can expose both; default to `pro-rate-by-day`.
leo-eng: from serving side we need a signal for "spot preemption aggressiveness" and a per-SKU `spot_window_hours` field so autoscaler can apply queueing/backoff. can we add that to the feed?
chris-vendor: yes. we'll include `spot_window_hours` and a numeric `preempt_risk` 0-100. typical values: GPU-ephemeral SKUs = 4-6h window, preempt_risk 60-80.
anya-product: heads-up — rollout plan for joint listings: if reserved vs spot billing conventions differ between partners we must surface a "billing type" badge in the Console and in marketplace docs. otherwise customers get surprised.
maria-partners: agreed. also need CSV schema to ingest into cost model. sample below — can you confirm fields we should expect?
ops-bot: uploaded file: partner_a_sku_window_example.csv
chris-vendor: confirm — that CSV looks good. we'll send weekly updates with changes.
---CSV SNIPPET---
sku,commit_start_utc,commit_end_utc,spot_window_hours,proration_rule,preempt_risk,invoice_cycle
core-a100-64,2025-01-01T00:00:00Z,2025-06-30T23:59:59Z,6,pro-rate-by-day,70,monthly
core-a40-32,2025-02-15T00:00:00Z,2025-08-14T23:59:59Z,4,pro-rate-by-hour,55,monthly
---END---
sam-finance: thanks — can we also get an "invoice_lag_days" column? finance needs to model cash flow and discounting.
chris-vendor: we can add `invoice_lag_days`. typical is 14-30. will include in next feed.
maria-partners: ok — next actions: chris to attach the full CSV schema and weekly feed cadence, leo to map `spot_window_hours` -> runtime autoscaler config, sam to add proration/invoice_lag to cost model, anya to draft Console badge copy. I'll follow up with a short doc. :rocket:
